adoption_rule: Research conclusions use original paper or official package source; discovery summaries are not authoritative.

paper.title: Construction of Rosenbrock–Wanner method Rodas5P and numerical benchmarks within the Julia Differential Equations package
paper.author: Gerd Steinebach
supports: Nonautonomous ROW stages include explicit h^2*gamma_i*f_t.
F_y and f_t are derivatives at the step start.
Exact smooth-problem classical order must be separated from stiff order reduction, inexact-Jacobian effects, and nonsmooth event/clamp behavior.
paper.adopted_method_claim: Existing Rodas5P method is reused; no new integrator or no-go claim.
